content_sections.heading: NRLM Karnataka Recruitment 2026 Official Job Notifications
content_sections.text: KSRLPS has published the Mysuru recruitment opportunities as individual job listings on its official government job portal rather than as one consolidated notification in the uploaded document. The 43-page merged PDF contains the official portal job details for all 12 listings, including vacancy information, educational qualifications, experience requirements, remuneration and application links. Official Job Portal: NRLM Karnataka Recruitment 2026

content_sections.heading: NRLM Karnataka Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the educational qualification and relevant work experience specified for their chosen post . The recruitment includes graduate-level and postgraduate-level positions in administration, rural livelihoods, agriculture, enterprise development, skill training and data management. Important: The Block Manager - Farm Livelihoods listing contains an additional general experience field stating 3+ years, while its qualification section provides separate experience routes of one, three and five years. Candidates using the one-year M.Sc. route should confirm eligibility through the official application authority. Minimum five years of relevant post-qualification experience. Preference for candidates with at least one year as Taluk Mission Manager or two years as Cluster Supervisor. Ability to read, write, type and speak Kannada and English. Knowledge of working with computers. Maximum age of 45 years according to the detailed job description. Applicants should possess a postgraduate qualification in Management, Commerce or Engineering. Preference is given to young professionals who have served under NRLM and possess a postgraduate qualification. The position involves supporting entrepreneurship development, enterprise finance, business support services, monitoring and field coordination. The listing also expects willingness to travel extensively and stay in villages when required.

content_sections.heading: NRLM Karnataka Recruitment 2026 Job Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Implement and monitor farm livelihood activities at block level. Support Mahila Kisan and farm livelihood community resource persons. Coordinate with block, cluster and other departments. Maintain MIS records and submit periodic reports. Support organic farming initiatives, market linkages and buyer-seller meetings. Manage One Stop Facility centre operations and enterprise support services. Assist entrepreneurs with business planning and access to finance. Coordinate among technical support agencies, community organizations and project staff. Support training, enterprise development and market opportunities. Maintain enterprise records, monitoring information and progress reports. Plan and monitor farm livelihood initiatives across the district. Coordinate with Block and Cluster livelihood personnel. Support capacity building, organic farming and community-level activities. Maintain monitoring and MIS reports. Develop market linkages and document successful initiatives. Support social mobilization and institutional development of Self Help Groups. Facilitate training and capacity building for community institutions. Coordinate with banks and other financial institutions for SHG financial inclusion. Monitor activities for vulnerable and socially excluded communities. Prepare programme reports, case studies and development plans. Support district and taluk programme management teams. Maintain office records, reports and files. Assist with MIS data entry and verification. Coordinate administrative activities and compliance requirements. Lead block-level mission implementation teams. Monitor programme activities and community institution development. Coordinate with banks, government departments and other stakeholders. Support annual planning and reporting requirements. Conduct regular field visits and programme reviews. Coordinate skill development awareness and mobilization activities. Support training candidate identification and counselling. Maintain skill registers and programme records. Coordinate with training providers and monitor placements. Track candidates after placement and report programme outcomes. Monitor project Management Information Systems. Ensure timely and accurate data entry. Collect and organize data-entry source documents. Verify entered data against supporting records. Prepare reports based on project performance information. The advertised position concerns non-farm livelihood activities. Candidates should refer to the detailed official listing for the precise responsibilities, reporting arrangements and operational requirements.

content_sections.heading: NRLM Karnataka Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply through the official NRLM Karnataka job portal from 30 October to 12 November 2026 . Official Application Portal: NRLM Karnataka Jobs Portal Candidates must create an account or sign in to submit their applications. Each advertised position has a separate job details page containing the applicable recruitment information and application option.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for NRLM Karnataka Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official job portal at jobsksrlps.karnataka.gov.in . Open the Recent Jobs or Careers section. Find the appropriate Mysuru district recruitment listing dated 30 October 2026. Select the desired post and review the number of vacancies, location, qualification, experience and salary. Click Sign In to Apply or Create an Account if not already registered. Complete the registration or candidate login process according to the portal instructions. Enter the required personal, educational and relevant experience details. Provide any additional information and documents requested by the application portal. Verify all submitted details before completing the application. Submit the application before 12 November 2026 . Retain the application confirmation or acknowledgement, if provided. Important: Candidates applying for Block Technical Coordinator must choose the correct taluk listing. Nanjangud, Mysuru, Heggadadevana Kote and Piriyapatna have separate application pages.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for NRLM Karnataka Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The uploaded job listings do not provide a uniform document-upload checklist. Depending on the post and portal instructions, candidates should keep the following supporting records ready: Relevant Graduation or Postgraduation certificates. Educational marksheets. Experience certificates supporting the prescribed work history. Valid identity and age-proof documents. Computer or language-related qualification documents, where applicable. Other documents specifically requested by the official application portal. Candidates should submit only the documents required by their selected job listing and ensure that qualification and experience information matches their original records.
